comparison.objective: Support a piano lid while the other arm raises and seats its prop; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual load support and prop insertion under sustained load versus counterholding, recessed-tool use, fine rotary adjustment and iterative response testing.
comparison.success_condition: Body requires lid raised, prop seated and lid safely resting, with irreversible failure for a fall; no complete spec version is present. Candidate requires two repeatable stops and verified adjustment retention.
comparison.reason: Bimanual support is shared, but supporting and propping a load is materially different from tuning an energy absorber.
